text.tspan: Agent under test (Klea Agent/RAG HTTP endpoint)
Agent under test (Klea Agent/RAG HTTP endpoint)
Load suite JSONL line by line, validate schema_version, case_id uniqueness and turn ordering (ADR-0056, ADR-0060)
[For each turn, sequential 1..N with no gaps]
a reader sees no run or a complete run, a leftover .tmp is an incomplete run
[For each case in suite and each seed]
pass_at_k is suite-level only and never a per-run field

svg.text: schedule case with seed
derive run_id = UUID v5 over case_id + seed
derive chat_id = UUID v5 over run_id + user_id, one chat session per run
skip run unless overwrite requested
report incomplete run, discard .tmp and redo
create runs/{run_id}.tmp/ with workspace/
resolve fixture paths against the case-file directory, reject absolute paths
copy fixtures shallow into runs/{run_id}/workspace/fixtures/, read-only
skip run, remove .tmp, log error
resolve model-backed roles plan, execute, eval, chat, user role is never model-resolved
instantiate RunMetricsCollector with run_id, case_id, run_dir
POST turn_input
SSE stream, buffered response with token and latency metadata
append turn content to transcript.jsonl
score turn output against expected_output
invoke LLM judge (optional, local or remote), return rubric score
record_evaluation_result, pass/fail plus score
append one metrics.jsonl line, record_type "turn" with schema_version, at the run root inside .tmp
retry with exponential backoff, up to 3 attempts
log error, mark case failed
finalize, append final run envelope record_type "run" as the last metrics.jsonl line
flush and fsync every file
write zero-byte COMPLETE last
atomic rename runs/{run_id}.tmp/ to runs/{run_id}/
append one O_APPEND line to runs/index.jsonl with run_id, case_id, status, timestamp, schema_version, metrics path
apply retention after publish
purge whole older run dirs, keep only run.json plus metrics.jsonl, rewrite index atomically
aggregate reads runs/index.jsonl only, never the run directories
compute suite-level pass_at_k over k runs, plus per-case pass/fail, token totals and cost
Reporter prints summary table and Markdown report
